analysis.narrativeEn:

· RSI trajectory (56.1 → 46.7) — Exited oversold, consolidating in neutral zone, indicating lack of direction.
· MACD histogram trajectory (3.3455 → 1.0003) — Slowing improvement and beginning to worsen, no trend reversal signal confirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $412.56) — Trading around the middle band, with a band width of 13.15% indicating a period of reduced volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($405.51) — Support zone based on Pivot Point (PP $406.95) and SMA100 ($407.32).
· Swing Resistance ($414.50) — Potential for short-term upward reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern — 5-day low ($407.88) > 20-day low ($372.72) forming a Higher Low; 5-day high ($436.04) < 20-day high ($436.04) not forming a Lower High, indicating consolidation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.88x) — Below 5-day average, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — Entry conditions for buy/sell not met, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
